periods.summary: Shizuku arrives in Vermillion as additional League medical support after Japan cannot spare Kiriko. When Ikki is reduced to scattered remains, she remains calm because she has prepared for exactly this kind of disaster. Refusing to lose him a second time, she activates Water World, an advanced form of Water Rebirth that disassembles Ikki's corpse into cells and reconstructs him. Missing and necrotic tissue makes normal healing impossible, so Shizuku temporarily grafts her own compatible cells into Ikki's body and manifests as a palm-sized semi-transparent version of herself. She assures Stella that Ikki can be revived and identifies Or-Gaule's weakness: Danse Macabre can stitch flesh and debris, but not ash. After the battle she continues treatment for thirty hours, also repairing Tatara's drug-damaged brain at Stella's request. Because she overturned an established death through her own ego, the League promotes her to A-rank. In Ikki's hospital room she explains that he is temporarily child-sized because only enough cells exist to build a ten-year-old body, and estimates he can regain his adult form in about six months. Before leaving, she rebukes Ikki for choosing a death-premised plan after promising Stella love, comparing it to the pain he felt when imagining Shizuku had sacrificed herself.

key_events.summary: Uses Water World and her own cells to reconstruct Ikki from death while Stella finishes Or-Gaule.
Explains Ikki's child body, receives A-rank promotion notice, and rebukes his self-sacrifice.
